Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lankan bowlers were superb tonight apart from Kulasekara who was the only one who proved to be expensive and wicketless. The score is a competitive one and the home side would be banking on the skipper to provide them with a blazing start. Will they be able to better their record at this venue? Join us in a bit to find out.

Sarkar too followed him and that put a lid on the scoring rate as the Lankans clawed their way back through Gunaratne and Prasanna in the middle overs. However, Bangladesh then recovered through the pair of Mahmudullah and Mosaddek Hossain as they steadied the ship quiet remarkably with a crucial stand of 57.

A good recovery from Bangladesh after a bit of stutter in the middle. Sri Lanka were right on the money with Malinga removing Tamim Iqbal in the very first over. But once that happened, Sarkar and Sabbir Rahman started to attack after the former got a reprieve from Malinga on a duck. They raised a 57-run stand quickly and then Prasanna with a superb run out saw the back of the latter.

BANGLADESH FINISH ON 155/6. Slower delivery and on a back of a length outside off, Hossain shuffles and looks to swipe it through mid-wicket but only ends up dragging it towards that region. Single taken.
Yorker outside off, Mortaza digs it out towards covers and runs one.

FOUR! Cheeky but effective! Kulasekara bowls a full toss outside off, Mortaza walks across his stumps and picks it up nicely. Gets it through backward square leg and earns himself a boundary. 150 comes up for Bangladesh.
Good change of pace as Kulasekara bowls a slower one outside off, Hossain carves it to deep cover for a single.
A brilliant yorker outside off, Mortaza stays rooted to his crease and jams it out towards covers for a run.
Fullish delivery well outside off, Hossain looks to drive it through covers but gets an outside edge towards third man. A run taken.
NUWAN KULASEKARA to bowl the final over!
Malinga bowls a full toss again but the good thing is that it is low and on the pads, Hossain only manages to clip it through mid-wicket for a single. A wicket and 7 runs from that over.
Low full toss outside off, Hossain chips it towards deep cover for a couple.
Beautifully bowled! Slips in the slower delivery outside off, Hossain dances down the track and doesn't have any clue about it. Ends up missing it completely.
Lasith bowls a yorker length delivery in line of the stumps, Mortaza makes room but only manages to get an inside edge towards fine leg. A single taken.
Wide! Malinga ends up bowling a full toss outside leg stump, Mortaza lets it go.
Full toss on the pads, Mortaza clips it through mid-wicket for a couple and gets off the mark.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA is the new man in!

OUT! Timber! A decent cameo from Mahmudullah comes to an end. Malinga sees Mahmudullah backing away and lives up to the reputation of bowling a yorker, Mahmudullah looks to run it down to third man but ends up getting an outside edge that deflects back onto his stumps.
FOUR! Placement to perfection! Good length delivery outside off, Hossain dabs it through point and the ball races to the fence.
Mahmudullah dances down the track and drills this one to long off for a single.

A shout for caught behind turned down! Fullish delivery outside off, Mahmudullah looks to force it through square of the wicket but misses as the ball sails into the gloves of Perera. The players appeal but the sound was of the bat hitting the ground.
This is good bowling from Hossain. Keeps it full and on leg stump, Hossain backs away and only manages to play it through wide mid on. A run taken.
Sanjaya aims for the slower delivery but ends up bowling a full toss on middle, Mahmudullah crouches and helps it down to fine leg for a single.
50-run stand is up between Mahmudullah and Hossain!
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Change of ends for VIKUM SANJAYA.
Lasith again attacks the pads and bowls a full toss, Hossain clips it through square leg for a run.
Smart bowling from Malinga. Bowls this one at a slower pace and outside off, Hossain only manages to defend it down the track.
Malinga again aims around the pads and gets it in the line he wants to. Mahmudullah nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Low full toss on the pads, Hossain tickles it towards fine leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Third man comes up...

FOUR! That's a delightful shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Mahmudullah extends his arms and caresses it through covers and the ball whistles away to the fence. That was pleasing to the eyes!
LASITH MALINGA is back on!

FOUR! Intelligent batting by Hossain! Similar delivery outside off, Hossain makes room and this time doesn't miss out. Places it through backward point and short third man to earn a boundary for himself.
Good change of pace! Slower delivery outside off, Hossain backs away and looks to place it through point but gets beaten.
Full toss outside off, Hossain plays it late but finds Prasanna at point. He picks up the ball and advances towards Hossain. Stares at him. Things are heating up here.
Full toss on the pads, clipped through front of square for a single.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah makes room and intends to go inside out but ends up slicing it over square of the wicket for a boundary.
Almost a yorker length ball on middle, Mahmudullah digs it out through mid-wicket and takes a run. Is aware of the situation and the batsmen come back for the second.
NUWAN KULASEKARA is back into the attack!

Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Mahmudullah clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a run. Wants the second but the fielder returns a sharp throw at the bowler's end to deny them. 10 runs from that over.
On a length on off, Mahmudullah comes down the track and swats it towards deep mid-wicket. Good running allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, nudged through square leg for a run.
Wide! Vikum looks to bowl a slower one but gets his line wrong again. It's going down leg as Hossain fails to glance it.

Brilliant fielding by Kapugedera! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Mossadek clips it with good timing through wide mid on. Kapugedera from long on hares to his right and makes a superb sliding stop. Two runs taken.
Wide! Sanjaya sprays this one down the leg side, Hossain misses his clip.
Good change of pace. On a length on middle and leg, Mahmudullah tucks it with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a run.
Straying on the pads, Hossain tickles it towards the short fine leg fielder and sets off for a run. The fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Hossain was safely home.
VIKUM SANJAYA is back into the attack!

FOUR! Good shot! Floated outside off, Mahmudullah goes inside out and  makes good connection. Pierces the gap in the deep to perfection to earn himself a boundary. Prasanna ends with figures of 4-0-19-1.
Flighted delivery, Hossain milks it nicely to long off for a single.
Leg bye! Tossed up delivery around leg stump, Mahmudullah looks to reverse sweep it but misses and is rapped on the pads as the ball rolls towards short third man. A leg bye taken!
Serves a juicy full toss outside off, Hossain just eases it through covers for a run.
Fullish delivery outside off, Mahmudullah slices it towards deep cover for a single.
Tossed up around off, Mahmudullah comes down the track and pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! That's cracked! Fuller length ball outside off and room to maneuver with, Hossain doesn't miss out and drives it with an open face through point for a boundary. That was good to watch.
Width on offer again and Mahmudullah taps it nicely towards cover-point for a run.
Fuller length ball outside off, Hossain dabs it towards cover-point for a sharp single.
Similar length ball outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it through point for a single.
Well played! A touch short and room on offer, Mahmudullah dabs it behind point and gets two runs for doing so.
Slower delivery outside off, driven to covers.
Fullish delivery on middle, milked down to long on for a single. A wicket and 3 runs from that over, good one for Sri Lanka.
Fullish outside off, driven to extra cover.
Tossed up delivery around off, Mahmudullah comes down the track and looks to play it across but misses and is rapped on the boot. No appeal from the hosts as the batsman had come way down the track.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish delivery around off, Mahmudullah lap sweeps it down to fine leg for a couple and gets off the mark.
MAHMUDULLAH walks in next!

OUT! Prasanna strikes! He bowls a slider outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to play it down the ground perhaps but ends up slicing it towards Gunaratne at cover-point. He makes no mistake and pouches it safely. Good passage of play for Sri Lanka.
A touch short outside off, Hossain dabs it towards short third man. Intended to play that a bit finer. 6 runs from that over.
Cutting in from around leg stumps, Shakib camps back and punches it down to long off. Single taken.
Slower delivery on middle and leg, Hossain clips it with soft hands towards short mid-wicket for an easy single.
Fullish delivery around the pads, Hasan sweeps it through backward square leg for a run.

Good fielding, Kapugedara! Slower delivery around middle and leg, Shakib makes room and lofts it down the ground past the bowler. Kapugedara runs to his left at long off and stops it with a brilliant stop. Two runs taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, skidding through a bit, Hossain nudges it through square leg for a single. Tight bowling!
Very full on off, Hossain manages to push it towards covers.
Around middle and leg, Sahkib sweeps it again and beats a dive of Malinga at square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floats it up around off, Sahkib gets down and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a double.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Hossain flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Shakib punches it back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop it. Just 2 and a wicket from the over.
Fullish in length, Shakib hits it hard but straight back to Asela.
Very full around off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Comes a step forward and works it towards mid-wicket.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN is the new man in.

OUT! Asela Gunaratne removes Rahim! Hurls a length ball, angling in, Rahim gets down and across to play the paddle scoop but completely misses the line as there is no pace on the ball to work with. He sees the off stump getting shattered and that is it for Mushfiqur. Gunaratne is delighted and Bangladesh are losing the plot now.
Good length delivery on middle, punched towards long on for a single.
Punched down to long on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Just short of Malinga! Nicely tossed up around off, Rahim once again opts for the reverse sweep but doesn't get enough on it this time. The ball just falls short of Malinga at short third man.
Floats it up around middle and leg, Shakib lunges and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball around off, Shakib gets back to punch it but ends up mistiming it back to Prasanna.
Loopy delivery around off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Time for some spin now. SEEKKUGE PRASANNA to roll his arm over.
Allows the ball to come on the pads and then tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Reverse sweep! Bowls it a bit wider outside off, Rahim quickly gets into the position and reverse sweeps it past backward point for a boundary.
Fuller on off, milked down to long off for another single.
A low full toss on the pads, Shakib flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Starts off with a cutter, coming in as Rahim defends it back to the bowler.
ASELA GUNARATNE to bowl now.
Leg bye! Fuller and strayed on the pads, Rahim misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side for one. A superb over, a double-wicket maiden.
SHAKIB AL HASAN comes out to bat.

OUT! Soumya Sarkar throws his start! Sri Lanka will be elated as they have removed two set batsmen. Sanjaya hurls a full length delivery, Sarkar makes room and lofts it down the ground. Gets no elevation and it's a simple take for Thisara Perera at long on who makes no mistake.
Another wide yorker, this is good bowling, giving no room. Sarkar mistimes it back to the bowler.
Wide yorker outside off, Sarkar tries jamming it out but fails to do so. A muted appeal for caught behind is turned down and there was no edge on that.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM strides out to bat.

OUT! Run out! Sabbir Rahman is a goner here! Length ball outside off, Rahman taps it towards covers and sets off for a quick single. Meanwhile, Prasanna charges towards the ball, picks it up and fires in a throw at the non-striker's end and it hits. They refer it upstairs and replays show Sabbir is just short of his crease. In fact, Sabbir changed the direction to avoid a beating from the throw that was coming and in the end pays the price for the same. A much-needed wicket for Sri Lanka.
A run out appeal against Sabbir Rahman has been referred upstairs. Prasanna has hit the bull's eye at the bowler's end and it looks close.
VIKUM SANJAYA comes back into the attack.

SIX! All over the fence! Where did that come from? Malinga completely lost his radar here. Bowls a full length delivery, Sarkar just swings his bat. Gets enough meat as the ball sails over backward square leg for a biggie. 17 off Malinga's over.
Good length delivery on middle, Rahman mistimes his pull to mid on for a single.
Nothing on a Free-Hit! Very full on the stumps, Rahman just manages to slice it towards covers. Sarkar wanted a single but is sent back in time.
Free Hit coming up... Meanwhile, the 50-run stand between Sarkar and Rahman comes up.

FOUR! Waist height no ball! The ball slips out of Malinga's hands and he ends up bowling it on the ribs. Sabbir Rahman just nudges it as the ball races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Malinga gets a warning as he bowls one more, he'll be out of the attack.
Nicely done! Fuller in length and just around off, Sarkar makes room and hits it past a diving point fielder. Some good running between the wickets allows them to get back for three.
Good execution! On a length, slower one again, Sarkar looks to run it down but this time he gets beaten by the lack of pace. The ball goes on the bounce to Kusal Perera behind the stumps.

Sloopy from Sanjaya! Malinga bowls a slow full toss outside off, Sarkar is up for it. He opens the face of the bat and dabs it fine down to third man. Sanjaya in the deep fumbles which allows them to come back for another.
LASITH MALINGA comes back for a bowl.
Very full on the stumps, pushed towards mid off for one. 12 from this over, good one for Bangladesh!
FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller in length and in the line of the leg stump, Sarkar anticipates it as he moves leg side, makes some room and drives it on the up past mid off for another boundary.
Full toss on middle and leg, worked with soft hands towards mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Up and over the infield! Safest shot to play during the Powerplay! Fuller length just around off, Sabbir Rahman makes room and looks to loft it over the off side. He slices it but it doesn't matter as the ball goes over covers to the fence.

Very full, dipping into the batsman, Sarkar whips it once again in the same area but this time a bit too wide from the fielder who still manages to get a hand on it. He takes the pace off and only a single is picked up. Good fielding from Asela Gunaratne.
Fuller and angling in, Soumya flicks it brutally but much to his dismay he finds the man at short mid-wicket.
Wide! Slower one down the leg side, Sarkar tries his best to slog it but fails to get any wood on it.
Fuller ball, dipping in, Sabbir stays back and offers a defense. 10 off the over!
Good length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards the off side.
Touch fuller outside off, Soumya crouches low, lets the ball come in and then dabs it behind square on the off side for a single.

FOUR! Easily done! Sanjaya is going a bit expensive here. Doles out a low full toss and provides too much of width as well. Sarkar latches onto it with a uppish drive through extra cover for another boundary. Runs flowing now for the visitors.
FOUR LEG BYES! Comes from around the wicket and strays on the pads, Sarkar tries to help it on its way with a flick but the ball kisses his pads and rockets to the fine leg fence.
Fuller in length and it's on the pads, Rahman flicks it uppishly through square leg for a single.
VIKUM SANJAYA comes into the attack.
Landed outside off, dabbed towards third man for an easy single.
Good length delivery on off, Sarkar looks to slog it across the line but gets a bottom edge that rolls past the sticks towards third man for one.
Good length, served across the batsman, Sarkar opens the face and steers it just past the man at point for a brace.
Wide! Good length, strangling down leg, Sarkar misses his flick.
FOUR! That's dispatched from the sight! Gets a length ball, Sarkar goes after it. He hoists it cleanly with a flat bat over mid-wicket and earns a boundary to his name.

A shout for an LBW! On a length and angling in, Sarkar looks to hoick it across but the ball goes off the pads towards the off side. Kulasekara appeals but the umpire is unmoved. It probably pitched outside leg stump.
Fuller in length and on the pads, Rahman flicks it past mid-wicket where the fielder tries to stop it but fails to do so. The ball goes through and they take three.
NUWAN KULASEKARA to bowl from the other end.

Dropped! This should have been taken! Sarkar gets a huge, huge reprieve. Fuller in length and angling in again, Sarkar looks to drive but the ball bobbles back to the bowler who in his followthrough quickly moves to his left but fails to cling onto it. Had this been taken, Bangladesh would have been in huge trouble. Nonetheless, superb first over from Malinga.

In the air... safe! Fuller and angling in, Sabbir looks to work it across the line but is a bit early into the stroke. Gets a leading edge which just evades the short extra cover fielder for a single.

FIVE WIDES! That took off, literally! Malinga after bowling the full deliveries opts for a bouncer. This rises off the deck and poor Kusal Perera couldn't cut if off even with a leap. The ball goes down to the fence and Bangladesh are away.
Bowls a slower full delivery, almost hits the yorker length. Sabbir jams it out. Brilliant stuff.
Fuller again and just around off, Sabbir calmly pats it back to Lasith.
SABBIR RAHMAN walks in at No. 3. Two slips in place now.

OUT! Bowled 'em! What a delivery this is! Absolute peach! Steams in, keeps it full and gets it to curl back in sharply as Tamim Iqbal looks to flick it across the line. Is beaten by the sheer pace as the ball brushes his pads and the middle stick goes for a walk. Malinga is all pumped up and so is the Colombo crowd. Iqbal walks back without troubling the scorers much.
Starts off with a full length delivery, curling back in a bit, Tamim lunges to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side.

The players and the umpires have come out in the middle. TAMIM IQBAL and SOUMYA SARKAR to open the batting for Bangladesh. LASITH MALINGA to start off with the new ball. A slip in place for him. Here we go...

1915 LOCAL UPDATE - Good news! The rain has eased off and the covers are coming off. We might have a resumption soon. We are hearing that the action will resume at 1945 local time. Overs won't be curtailed.

The players are out for their respective national anthems. Oh dear, the heaven seems to have opened up. It certainly has. The players rush to their dressing rooms once the anthems are done and now a huge bunch of groundsmen come running in with covers. A false start then. All we can say is stay with us...

UPUL THARANGA says it looks a good wicket and hence the toss doesn't matter to them. Adds it won't rain much as the last couple of days were dry. Hopes that they can change their record at this venue.

MASHRAFE MORTAZA says they will bat first. Hopes there won't be any dew. Further says they aren't relying on rain and want to put runs on the board. Informs that this will be his last T20I series for Bangladesh and thanks everyone for the support given to him for the past 15-16 years. MOHAMMAD SAIFUDDIN makes his International debut for Bangladesh.
TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Russel Arnold doing the pitch reports says that it is a hard pitch and the ball will come onto the bat. Feels that it will be conducive for strokeplay. Adds that 175-180 will be a good score. Mentions that the toss won't be much of a factor as the pitch will remain even throughout. Adds that the boundaries are big and it will be a cracker of a contest.

On the other hand, the home side will look to carry forward their winning momentum under their skipper, Upul Tharanga. They have a good blend of experience and youth to go with. Their recent T20I series wins in South Africa and Australia will only boost their confidence. There is some rain predicted in Colombo. Let's hope it doesn't play spoilsport.

Hello and a warm welcome for the first T20I of the 2-match series between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh at the R. Premadasa Stadium, Colombo. The visitors would be happy with the way they have fared so far in this tour. They have proved their mettle in alien conditions and can't be taken lightly. Though they have lost their last 7 games in the shortest format, they will be banking upon their explosive side to pose a fierce challenge to the hosts.
